nodes.title: Exclude source_metadata from the public surface
nodes.summary: Codifies the outcome of the runtime-availability measurement: read_native_table requires a filesystem path; PackagedCatalogArtifact exposes only provider_info, products, stations, and station_products; native.parquet is committed for eleven providers but absent for br_ana and no_nve; and pyproject.toml uses uv_build without packaging configuration that creates those missing tables. Because an installed package cannot supply source metadata for every provider, source_metadata is neither implemented nor exported. Acceptance evidence is an installed-package public-surface regression test proving source_metadata is absent.
